Developer learning path
body:
View email in browser <[[https://click.explore.redhat.com/v/NDI3LVRCQy00NzQAAAGkQEy1bvAB-OLeb3qnNobDXzTNJ0nHlbLAut9KTdXLYryikVeselFJDcw76W_SLpxH5tWZjCM=]]>
Developer learning paths
Get started with vLLM <https://click.explore.redhat.com/NDI3LVRCQy00NzQAAAGkQEy1b3ToFjHxXXFkbI5aZU9culvbGst6-pVbBnVhqjFIZnc4s-puX4syKQvtFWrI2f8ykA4=>
Discover how to compress, serve, and benchmark LLMs with vLLM to optimize your AI inference pipelines.

Foundations of OpenShift <https://click.explore.redhat.com/NDI3LVRCQy00NzQAAAGkQEy1bhO-wUM8AwGgugZ74JppaBkh6vwusTZFNoaN2rkl9RnDtlXh6NgedP9IKPjN7KDknY0=>
Master core container concepts through hands-on experience deploying and managing applications on a no-cost OpenShift cluster.

YAML essentials for Ansible <https://click.explore.redhat.com/NDI3LVRCQy00NzQAAAGkQEy1brZyPQarIfYhLe76tAex59GCColR2J_2EAFOZOVz0XUTSHYmYp5pbd-xkzoI2pSHCRs=>
Explore the fundamentals of YAML, a straightforward data serialization language, through practical Ansible examples.

Download and install the Red Hat OpenShift CLI <https://click.explore.redhat.com/NDI3LVRCQy00NzQAAAGkQEy1b6LbTvHm1tD6qX5tc_g5tg6h5gfz2cq6nYeyCl25TGlH-rL44CXNNchHUDgvZ0FLhJs=>
Install the oc command-line interface (CLI) to manage and interact with your Red Hat OpenShift cluster directly from the terminal.

Container internals <https://click.explore.redhat.com/NDI3LVRCQy00NzQAAAGkQEy1bmIO0nG0p-efs2fHl9jk1bsPn3ptkI2_eycRYz0V4rfu27APo4Lz1ZO0JOMFuCmrt4w=>
Gain a practical understanding of container architecture, tailored for developers building applications on OpenShift and Kubernetes.

Bridging the gap: Integrate legacy VMs into a zero trust service mesh <https://click.explore.redhat.com/NDI3LVRCQy00NzQAAAGkQEy1bsP-Y66ifSvOzbM7ezKrPyPrsFneCp06SuVe4h2OxYTilxk7Fzp6GuakRAfDfHmsEmk=>
Discover how to integrate legacy virtual machines into modernized workloads using Red Hat OpenShift Service Mesh.

Integrate Red Hat Developer Hub with Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform <https://click.explore.redhat.com/NDI3LVRCQy00NzQAAAGkQEy1bvpQg_eWrRAHigFoBKW7ShxTcvsEh6HfiCHgAZWPpuW7NWggY2aHdYoHICHWvrvc5k4=>
Connect Red Hat Developer Hub with Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform under a single sign-on system using Red Hat build of Keycloak.

Build a hardened Flask stack and deploy it in image mode for Red Hat Enterprise Linux <https://click.explore.redhat.com/NDI3LVRCQy00NzQAAAGkQEy1bvZbDgA8Atdwhpc1nTp1lzY8iKpvdyckoUQbqtZO7LP8GFg15rcooak5LGKXu5EKZOU=>
Build a Python Flask application on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 using Red Hat Hardened Images and bootc to create bootable, verified virtual machines with a trusted software supply chain.

Deploy OpenShift Data Foundation across availability zones using Multus <https://click.explore.redhat.com/NDI3LVRCQy00NzQAAAGkQEy1bso96qvsJsF1kKnSEUnaMytLiyHwkXNRRE_GRIDaIVQwUznuulOVlKBmJH0EIwTQhrc=>
Enhance multi-AZ OpenShift deployments using Multus for high-performance, fault-tolerant workloads.

How to set up Open Data Hub 3.x External Identity Provider and Gateway on ROSA <https://click.explore.redhat.com/NDI3LVRCQy00NzQAAAGkQEy1b72LEQ-sVGTxhszEmfGHk0C1jSCTU0TIAuKhBw_beNN0Z6vx7SDJi4dUeAGS_uao12I=>
Configure authentication through an external identity provider (IdP) for cluster logins and the Open Data Hub gateway using Open Data Hub 3.x with external OpenID Connect.

### Teetotal Trump’s Strange Weakness for Whiskey




--------------------
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/affec6b3-3d89-425a-8333-c9fc935f3143/image.png?t=1789407167)
Follow image link: (https://www.newsweek.com/teetotal-donald-trump-whiskey-ireland-canada-trade-12437911)
Caption: 


--------------------
Twice this year, the president has publicly promised a whiskey carve-out after somebody he likes asked for one.

The tempting conclusion is that he is a soft touch for whiskey. Flattered by monarchs, charmed by sportsmen, and sentimental about a drink he never tried.

[Has whiskey become an unlikely tool in the president’s brand of trade diplomacy?](https://www.newsweek.com/teetotal-donald-trump-whiskey-ireland-canada-trade-12437911)

### 
Measles Is the Deadly Disease of America’s Trust Crisis

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/17b08293-9a57-4ab7-a77c-a86402a50813/image.png?t=1789409548)
Follow image link: (https://www.newsweek.com/measles-outbreak-vaccine-trust-crisis-america-12439511)
Caption: 

Measles is becoming a physical manifestation of a political problem. 

Americans have grown increasingly skeptical of the institutions that tell them what is safe and whom to believe. The virus provides a very harsh test of what happens when that distrust moves from [polling questions into private medical decisions.](https://www.newsweek.com/measles-outbreak-vaccine-trust-crisis-america-12439511)

Read more (https://www.newsweek.com/measles-outbreak-vaccine-trust-crisis-america-12439511)

### Supreme Court Ruling on Mail Ballot Changes: What To Know


--------------------
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/854a7623-aaa4-4d3d-b7c7-df19abbc9ba8/image.png?t=1789409674)
Follow image link: (https://www.newsweek.com/supreme-court-ruling-mail-ballot-changes-what-know-12437593)
Caption: 

The U.S. Supreme Court is set to weigh in on whether President Donald Trump's administration can implement new mail ballot requirements ahead of November's midterm elections.

Almost a third of voters cast mail ballots, so the outcome of the legal fight could have a significant impact on voting practices, particularly in the states where mail voting is universal and popular.

Read more (https://www.newsweek.com/supreme-court-ruling-mail-ballot-changes-what-know-12437593)

### Trump’s AI Gamble Breaks His World War III Rule


--------------------
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/9911dfe3-b1d6-4ab8-a61d-ab574e1d6fc1/image.png?t=1789409908)
Follow image link: (https://www.newsweek.com/trump-ai-wwiii-risk-anthropic-12439135)
Caption: 


--------------------
Asked at his Irish golf course on Sunday whether the AI industry should slow down or face more regulation, Donald Trump didn’t need to waste any time prompting ChatGPT to help him answer.

Trump replied that “very negative forces” were raising “things that won’t happen.” And while guardrails were possible, America leads China, and “whoever wins AI, wins.”

But it also inverted a standard Trump has applied to catastrophic risks elsewhere.

[**Specifically, in the Russia-Ukraine war.**](https://www.newsweek.com/trump-ai-wwiii-risk-anthropic-12439135)

Read more (https://www.newsweek.com/trump-ai-wwiii-risk-anthropic-12439135)

Ed Sheeran has made neutrality part of his superpower. One man, one guitar, songs designed to unite a stadium without requiring anyone in attendance to agree on much except for loving the very concept of love.

An industry-wide push to responsibly slow its advancement, and apocalyptic warnings from some of the technology’s leading developers, have dampened enthusiasm for artificial intelligence and raised concerns that one of its long-feared economic consequences—the AI bubble “bursting”—could be here.

Capital One reserves the right to end or change the terms of this
offer at any time prior to you accepting the offer, with or
without notice. Changing the terms of this offer could result in
a change to any of the offer requirements such as, but not
limited to, the required deposit amounts, qualified external
deposit sources, the bonus amounts or expiration date. Please
note that once your account is opened with a promotional code,
the terms of the offer will not change without us notifying you
in advance. Offers may vary.

If you have or had an open
- 360 Performance Savings

- 360 Savings

- 360 Money Market

- Savings Now

- or Confidence Savings account
as a primary or secondary account holder with Capital One on or
after Jan. 1, 2024, you will be ineligible for the bonus. If your
account is in default, closed or suspended, or otherwise not in
good standing, you will not receive the bonus.

Certain deposit transactions initiated through the Capital One
website to retrieve funds from your external account are subject
to limits. If you are subject to these limits, in order to meet
the offer requirements, you would need to initiate the deposit by
another external method, such as mobile deposit or setting the
initial deposit to send (rather than be retrieved) from your
external financial institution.

Here’s the full scoop on how to earn your bonus:

STEP 1—Open a 360 Performance Savings account on or after April
15, 2026, at 12:00 a.m. ET. When you open your account, ensure
the promo code EARN1500 is entered in the Promo Code box.

STEP 2—Initial Funding Period. Deposit a total of $5,000 or more
of new money from externally sourced funds (transfers between
Capital One and Capital One associated accounts will not qualify)
within the first 15 days of account opening (Initial Funding
Period).

STEP 3—Hold Period. You will earn a bonus once you’ve maintained
an account balance at or above $5,000 or more for 90 days
following the Initial Funding Period with the balance held until
11:59 p.m. ET on the 90th day. The Initial Funding Period is
defined as the first 15 days from account opening, and the 90‑day
Hold Period does not begin until after the full 15‑day Initial
Funding Period. Funds must be held until 11:59 p.m. ET on day 90.

When will I get my bonus?

Capital One will deposit the bonus into your account within 60
days after you have completed all the requirements, as follows:
Step 1

associated timeframes
Keep in mind that the 90‑day Hold Period (Step 3) does not start
until after the full 15‑day Initial Funding Period (Step 2).

The amount of your bonus will be determined as follows:

$75 bonus—The new money deposited from an external bank during
the Initial Funding Period was between $5,000‑$19,999.99, and you
maintained an account balance within this range for 90 days
following the Initial Funding Period with the balance held until
11:59 p.m. ET on the 90th day.

$300 bonus—The new money deposited from an external bank during
the Initial Funding Period was between $20,000‑$49,999.99, and
you maintained an account balance within this range for 90 days
following the Initial Funding Period with the balance held until
11:59 p.m. ET on the 90th day.

$750 bonus—The new money deposited from an external bank during
the Initial Funding Period was $50,000‑$99,999.99, and you
maintained an account balance within this range for 90 days
following the Initial Funding Period with the balance held until
11:59 p.m. ET on the 90th day.

$1,500 bonus—The new money deposited from an external bank during
the Initial Funding Period was $100,000 or more, and you
maintained an account balance at or above that Deposit Amount for
90 days following the Initial Funding Period with the balance
held until 11:59 p.m. ET on the 90th day.

If at any time during the 90 days following the Initial Funding
Period your account balance drops into a lower tier, you will be
rewarded that tier’s cash bonus. If your account balance
decreases to an amount less than $5,000, you will not qualify for
a cash bonus. In addition, any additional deposits made during
this Hold Period will not qualify you for a higher tier bonus.

Capital One will deposit the bonus into your account within 60
days after you have completed all the requirements above,
including fulfilling the 90‑day holding period. If your account
is in default, closed or suspended, or otherwise not in good
standing, you will not receive the bonus. This offer cannot be
combined with any other 360 Performance Savings account opening
offers. Only one promotional code is accepted per account. Bonus
is only valid for one new 360 Performance Savings account.
Bonuses are considered interest and will be reported on IRS form
1099‑INT.

What are considered externally sourced funds?

Capital One considers externally sourced funds as any funds that
are deposited into your account from a source (such as another
financial institution) that was not affiliated with Capital One
prior to Jan. 1, 2025.

What you need to know about the 360 Performance Savings account:

360 Performance Savings accounts don’t have ATM or debit cards,
or check-writing capabilities. There’s no monthly cycle service
charge for this account, and no minimum balance required to open
or maintain the account. Our savings accounts permit no more than
six (6) transfers per statement cycle to a third party or to any
of your other deposit accounts at Capital One. There is no limit
in the number of transfers that you may make into your account.
Note: We are currently not enforcing the transfer limits. You’ll
be notified if we choose to reimpose these limits. This account
is subject to approval.

A rate of 3.00% Annual Percentage Yield (APY) applies to all account balances. Advertised rates are variable and effective as of Sept. 14, 2026. Rates are subject to change at any time before or after account opening.

To calculate interest, we apply a daily periodic rate to the
principal in the account each day.

Compounding and crediting—Interest on your account will be
compounded and credited on a monthly basis. Your account will
only receive an interest posting if the amount earned during the
month rounds to at least $0.01.

The claims made regarding the competitiveness of our 360
Performance Savings account rate are based on Curinos Inc.
national percentile data for savings accounts on balances of $1.

Friend,

We’re guessing you’re someone who cares about birds. (After all, you’re part of the Cornell Lab of Ornithology community!) So we’re swooping in to tell you about an easy way you can help protect them.

A brief summary of [OpenAI Developer Community][1] since 2026-09-05 20:00:19 UTC

43 New Topics
2964 New Users


 
 ### Popular Topics

 [API image creation moderation: improve details to include the reasons furnished to ChatGPT][2]

 Reason for denial surfaced: ChatGPT
Agentic persistence is shown in this image against inability to create from art no longer stolen from the collective good by corporations, and gives more details when in ChatGPT: 
 ![image](https://us1.discourse-cdn.com/openai1/original/4X/a/2/2/a22d546541e74ec12ff77f37744bf410b70973b5.png) 
Reason for denial obfuscated: API
API however, such as sending to gpt-image-2.5: 

Image concept depicted: “Watch out for Tiggers - they’ll drop on you!” 
Use only the style of original imagery originating from the public domain, pre-1930, e.g., the entirety of A.A. Milne children’s corpus: When We Were Very Young (1924); Winnie-the-Pooh (1926) Now We Are Six (1927) The House at Pooh Corner (1928) 

Returns only “other” from what must be the same inspection reasoning: 
moderation_details: {"moderation_stage": "output", "categories": ["other"]} 
“Other” can also arise from obscure input reasons such as celebrity depictions - where OpenAI and its model knows the re...

 
 [🚀 GPT-6 Astra Challenge on Product Hunt][3]

 OpenAI and Product Hunt challenge you to build something ambitious with GPT-6 Astra. 
Submissions are open now. Build with Astra and launch on Product Hunt by September 18, 2026. 
Five winners will each receive $10,000 in OpenAI API credits, a year of ChatGPT Pro for up to two team members, and promotion by OpenAI. 
Join: GPT-6 Astra Challenge
If you’re participating, share what you’re building and use this thread to discuss ideas and team up!

 
 [Astra – A noticeable drop in quality compared to how it was at launch][4]

 I’ve noticed a significant drop in Astra’s quality. 
At launch, Astra delivered truly precise iterations without needing retries. Today, I have to say it’s on par with SOL. 
Same task, same level of understanding—simple commands, yet the task isn’t completed. It requires repeated attempts and explanations. 
So, has the quality dropped?

 
 [Pro 5x → Pro 20x upgrade issue (Google Play)][5]

 Hi everyone, 
I would like to ask if anyone has experienced issues when upgrading from Pro 5x to the Pro plan with the 20x usage option through Google Play. 
Looking for users who had a similar upgrade experience and how it was resolved. 
Thank you

 
 [Again, I was redirected back to Support][6]

 I am experiencing exactly the escalation loop being discussed here. 
I have had an existing OpenAI Support case unresolved for approximately one week: Case #14347347. 
I contacted the Community specifically to ask what escalation path exists when the normal Support channel itself is not providing a substantive resolution. 
Instead, I was repeatedly redirected back to the same Support channel I was already using. 
I even created a separate Community post making it explicit that I was not asking the Community to resolve my private account or billing issue. I was asking whether an OpenAI staff member could flag my already-existing unresolved case for internal escalation. 
Again, I was redirected back to Support. 
This creates a circular process: 
Support case remains unresolved → ask about escalation → redirected to Support → explain that Support is the problem → redirected to Support again. 
I understand that private account matters cannot be resolved publicly. I am not asking for that. 
...

 

 


 ### Popular Posts

 _j - [Introducing GPT-6-Astra: The most intelligent and aligned model in the world][7]

 I want maximum “74%” of whatever this is, though == “xhigh”. That’s the “+1%” that we unlock at the frontier of +150% token cost.
 cm.clerk532 - [Codex Rate Limits Discussion Thread][8]

 Astra’s Token Burn Is Unsustainable 
I’ve been testing GPT-6 Astra in Codex against the type of long-running repository work I normally perform with GPT-5.6 Sol, and the difference in usage consumption is extreme enough that Astra is currently impractical for my workflow. 
Test Configuration / Observed Results 
• Model: GPT-6 Astra 
• Reasoning effort: Medium 
• Workload: Standard software-development task in an existing project repository 
• Concurrent Codex activity: None 
• Runtime: Approximately 40 minutes 
• Files affected: 12 Python files 
• Code created or modified: 758 lines 
• Code deleted: 46 lines 
• Weekly allowance before run: Approximately 87% remaining 
• Weekly allowance after run: Approximately 47% remaining 
• Weekly allowance consumed: Approximately 40 percentage points during a single run 
I ran Astra against one of my standard project repositories. Before starting the task, my Codex weekly allowance showed approximately 87% remaining. Nothing else was running again...
 _j - [Introducing GPT Images 2.5 in the API and ChatGPT][9]

 If using ChatGPT, and using reasoning effort, you might observe an image generated - and then a “retry” or an edit. I’ve had this happening already in days past. One image is shown - that you have to copy and save fast. Then it is replaced irrecoverably. Attempts to curb this fail: 
 ![image](https://us1.discourse-cdn.com/openai1/original/4X/5/b/2/5b28cebbe78e2c5f063c24e6c76dce182893add3.png) 
Or result in confusion: 
 ![image](https://us1.discourse-cdn.com/openai1/original/4X/f/4/5/f456cf296043d3bf7bd4fd2ae6f4256d75983857.png) 
It may be reasoning model “agentic” behavior attempting to loop and “improve” - but the edit based on image input is worse. 
Using “instant”, this does not seem to happen. There’s a progress percentage indicator now you can watch. 
Edit: this now near-identical initial that is retouched is now labeled “preview” over the image, so seems intentional behavior. I would encourage the former also be offered as there is nuance lost as much as there is enhancement gain...
 niclas.vestlund - [Astra in Action: Share your Builds, Breakthroughs & Aha Moments][10]

 I’ve only owned a 3D printer for about a week, and this is what I ended up making with Astra. Meet Big Bro :crab: 
 ![big-bro-real-print](https://us1.discourse-cdn.com/openai1/optimized/4X/7/f/1/7f13322730874af5d2273c3f9139c5abce0e4072_2_666x500.jpeg) 
The finished print, running VibePulse on my ESP32 display. 
I started out building websites and apps with AI. That led me into hardware and VibePulse, my open-source software for small ESP32 displays. I had the software working, but my screen needed a stand. 
Earlier that week, I’d tried designing one with Sol and Fabel 5. There were some interesting ideas, but I couldn’t get to something I was happy with. Then I tried Astra in Codex. 
The part that surprised me most was seeing my measurements turn into printed parts that actually fitted. Some of the fits felt almost eerily precise. I was still the one measuring and testing, but seeing the result come off the printer was pretty special. 
We started with mockups, picked a design, and work...

### How Jimmy Kimmel and Disney Learned to Fight Trump


--------------------
The battle of comedians, broadcasters and federal regulators has once again reached the courtroom and the nation’s airwaves, reigniting a conflict that cuts to the heart of First Amendment issues in the U.S.


--------------------
September 17 will mark one year since Brendan Carr, President Donald Trump’s chair of the Federal Communications Commission (FCC), urged media companies and broadcasters to drop comedian Jimmy Kimmel’s show after the late-night host said the “MAGA gang” was attempting to “score political points” from the death of Charlie Kirk. Kimmel joked about Trump’s apparently insincere reaction to the death of the 31-year-old conservative activist, comparing it to “how a 4-year-old mourns a goldfish.”

President Donald Trump has said that he would like to see a united Ireland, saying that "it's going to happen eventually."

Sitting next to Irish prime minister Micheál Martin on Saturday hours after arriving in Dublin, Trump was asked about the prospect of the Republic of Ireland joining with Northern Ireland, which is part of the United Kingdom.

“I don't want to cause any problems, but I will tell you, I'd love to see it unified," he replied.

About this message
Questions? Give us a buzz at 800‑655‑2265 to talk to a real person. We’re here 7 days a week, 8 a.m.‑11 p.m. ET.

The Referral Program Terms are in addition to any agreements between you and Capital One, including the Capital One Terms of Service, as applicable (collectively, the “Referral Terms”). The Referral Terms are incorporated by reference and shall apply to your participation in the Refer a Friend Program (“Referral Program”), including, if necessary, to resolve any disputes between you and Capital One related to or arising out of the Referral Program.

Eligibility

 - The Referral Program is open to primary account holders with an open eligible Capital One 360 Checking account in good standing (e.g., not suspended, restricted, or otherwise in default).
 - Referral Program offers are not available if you are a Capital One call center employee or an employee of Capital One Bank branches or Cafes.
Process

 - You may refer a Friend with the link we send to you or that you retrieve through your sign-in to online banking.
 - You may send the link to a Friend through email, text message or other means you choose by copying the referral link and sharing it yourself.
 - Capital One may pre-populate a message if you choose to send the referral link by email or text message, but you have the ability to edit the entire message before sending and must send the message.
 - By participating in the Referral Program, you represent and warrant that you have the necessary rights, permissions and consents from Friends to send them the referral link by email, text message or other means. 
Bonus fulfillment

 - Referral offers and referral bonuses are individual to you and cannot be transferred.
 - You can refer Friends and family to Capital One at any time, but referral bonus amounts are individual offers which may only be available for a limited time.
 - In order to receive a referral bonus:
 1. Your Friend must use the referral link you sent them, and complete the account opening process through that link for you to receive a bonus.
 2. Your Friend must open a Capital One 360 Checking Account.
 3. Your Friend must be a new Capital One checking customer. If they have or had an open 360 Checking, Simply Checking or Total Control Checking account as a primary or secondary account holder with Capital One on or after Jan. 1, 2024, both you and your Friend will be ineligible for the bonus.
 4. Your Friend must make 2 Qualifying Direct Deposits of $500 or more within 75 days of account opening. A Qualifying Direct Deposit is a regular periodic payment, such as salary, pension, government payments (for example, Social Security), or other monthly income that occurs as an automated clearing house (ACH) or real-time payment network credit from your employer or an outside entity not affiliated with Capital One prior to Jan. 1, 2025.
 5. Your account and your Friend’s account must be open and in good standing for you and your Friend to receive the bonus. If either account closes prior to the delivery of the bonus, no bonus will be awarded to you.
 - It may take up to 135 days after a Friend opens an account to see your referral bonus in your account if all requirements are met.
 - Earn up to $50 per referral link once your Friend opens and meets the bonus requirements, up to $500 a year.
 - Bonuses count toward the maximum bonus for the year in which you receive the bonuses and not when you made the referral.
 - Bonus may be subject to tax-related reporting for the year you receive it. We may be required to send you, and file with the IRS, Form 1099‑MISC. Please consult with a tax advisor for questions about the impact of this form.
Rules and restrictions

 - If you have other Capital One accounts that are not in good standing, you may not be eligible for the Referral Program. If you close your only Checking account, you will also not be eligible to refer a friend.
 - Spamming, harassment, misrepresentations in connection with the Referral Program, and fraudulent activity are prohibited. By participating in the Referral Program, you agree to remain in compliance with all applicable laws, including laws governing commercial emails and telemarketing.
 - You may only receive up to 10 Checking bonus referrals in a calendar year.
Additional terms

 - We reserve the right to alter, change or terminate the Referral Program at any time.
 - We reserve the right to disqualify you from participation in the Referral Program in the event of fraud, abuse of program privileges or violation of the Terms as determined at our discretion. Such termination may result in forfeiture of any referral bonuses currently in progress that have not yet been paid.
 - Account closure or suspension may result in the loss of any referral bonuses that haven’t been applied to your account yet.
 - We reserve the right to delay or not enforce any of our rights under the Referral Program without waiving or losing our right to enforce them later.
 - When you share your referral link, you will reveal that you have a product with Capital One.
What you need to know about the 360 Checking account:

A rate of 0.10 Annual Percentage Yield (APY) applies to accounts with balances between $0-$9,999.99, $10,000.00-$24,999.99, $25,000.00-$49,999.99, $50,000-$99,999.99, and $100,000 or more. 360 Checking is a tiered-rate account. Advertised rates are variable and effective as of Sept. 12, 2026. Rates in any tier are subject to change at any time before or after account opening.

Compounding and crediting—Interest on your account will be compounded and credited on a monthly basis. Your account will only receive an interest posting if the amount earned during the month rounds to at least $0.01.

The 360 Checking account has no monthly cycle service charge and no minimum balance required to open or maintain the account.

Smartphone access is needed to use mobile banking and the mobile app. Check with your service provider for details on specific fees and charges.

The site may be unavailable during normal maintenance or due to unforeseen circumstances.

Early paycheck is available for 360 Checking customers that set up direct deposit with their employer or other payer to receive electronic deposits of regular periodic payments (such as salary, pension or government benefits). Certain non-payroll and tax payments are not eligible for early paycheck. Early direct deposits may be available to you up to 2 days earlier, however, we are dependent on the timing of your payer’s payment instructions and therefore you may not always see your direct deposits arrive early. Early paycheck eligibility may vary between pay periods and daily/transaction limits apply. 

It may take two cycles for your direct deposits to take effect.

Si tienes dificultades para acceder a la página de cancelación de suscripción, gestionar tus preferencias o entender por qué recibes este correo, puedes contactar directamente a nuestro equipo de soporte en support@maxionresearch.com. Nuestro objetivo es proporcionar una respuesta en un plazo razonable y atender tus inquietudes de manera efectiva. Nuestra comunicación está diseñada para ser lo más inclusiva posible, aunque siempre hay margen de mejora. Si tienes sugerencias sobre cómo hacer que nuestros correos sean más accesibles o relevantes, no dudes en compartirlas. Cómo darse de baja o gestionar tus preferencias. Si en algún momento nuestros correos dejan de ser relevantes para ti, no hay resentimientos. Puedes gestionar fácilmente tus preferencias de correo o darte de baja usando el enlace proporcionado más abajo. Al hacer clic en el enlace de cancelación de suscripción, serás dirigido a una página donde podrás ajustar tus preferencias de comunicación (por ejemplo, recibir menos correos o solo sobre temas específicos) o eliminarte completamente de nuestra lista. El proceso es sencillo y cualquier cambio se aplicará de inmediato. No usamos trucos ni estrategias para mantenerte suscrito. Nuestra prioridad es asegurarnos de que nuestros correos aporten valor a tu día y, si no es así, respetamos tu decisión de dejar de recibirlos. Información legal. Cumplimos con todas las leyes y regulaciones aplicables sobre comunicación por correo electrónico. Esto incluye adherirse a la normativa vigente y mantener los más altos estándares en comunicación basada en el consentimiento. Tu confianza es importante y trabajamos diligentemente para asegurar que cada correo que recibas cumpla con estos requisitos. Si necesitas aclaraciones adicionales sobre nuestras políticas de cumplimiento u obligaciones legales, no dudes en preguntar. La transparencia y la responsabilidad son fundamentales en nuestra estrategia de comunicación y estaremos encantados de proporcionar más detalles si es necesario. Información de contacto. Nos esforzamos por garantizar que todos los canales de comunicación estén abiertos y disponibles para ti. Ya sea una pregunta, comentario o inquietud, nuestro equipo está listo para ayudarte. Para asistencia, contacta a nuestro equipo por correo electrónico respondiendo a este mensaje o escribiendo a support@maxionresearch.com. Gracias por mantenerte conectado. Nuestro objetivo es una comunicación clara y confiable, fácil de consultar posteriormente. Los correos electrónicos son una de las muchas formas en que nos mantenemos en contacto, pero entendemos que no son perfectos para todos. Si prefieres otro medio para comunicarte o mantenerte informado, háznoslo saber. Ya sea a través de redes sociales, una llamada directa u otro canal, estamos abiertos a encontrar la manera más efectiva de compartir información contigo. Cada correo enviado tiene como objetivo proporcionar valor, y apreciamos sinceramente tu tiempo y atención. Este pie de página ha sido diseñado para garantizar transparencia, proporcionar información esencial y ofrecerte control total sobre tus preferencias de comunicación. Esperamos que cumpla con tus expectativas, pero si deseas mejoras, siempre estamos dispuestos a escucharte. Atentamente, El equipo de soporte de Maxion Research --- For our Canadian and French Subscribers, here's the French version of our email policy: Bonjour. Ce message couvre les mises à jour que vous avez demandées : préférences, confirmations de commande, avis d'expédition et rappels de service. Il est possible d'y répondre et il est pris en charge par notre équipe chez Maxion Research. Votre interaction avec notre contenu, quel qu'en soit le format, est appréciée. Nous accordons de l'importance à votre temps et à la confiance que vous accordez à nos communications. Merci d'être un membre actif de notre communauté, et nous nous réjouissons de poursuivre nos échanges à l'avenir. Vous recevez cet e-mail parce qu'à un moment donné, vous avez choisi de recevoir des mises à jour, des actualités ou des informations sur un sujet spécifique que nous avons précédemment abordé ou partagé. Que ce soit par le biais d'un abonnement, de l'envoi d'un formulaire ou d'une autre forme de communication, vos informations ont été partagées volontairement, et nous respectons votre décision de vous connecter avec nous. Merci d'avoir pris le temps de lire cet e-mail. Ce message fait partie d'une conversation continue entre nous, et je souhaite prendre un moment pour vous assurer une transparence totale quant à la raison pour laquelle vous avez reçu ce message, à la manière dont vos informations sont traitées et à ce à quoi vous pouvez vous attendre dans les futurs e-mails. Si vous vous interrogez sur la nature de notre correspondance, soyez assuré que nous visons à maintenir tous nos e-mails pertinents, opportuns et à éliminer tout encombrement inutile. Cela inclut le respect de votre boîte de réception et l'abstention d'envoyer des messages non pertinents. Nous maintenons un envoi authentifié pour garantir la fiabilité. Nos domaines et adresses IP d'envoi sont vérifiés, et nous maintenons l'alignement de l'expéditeur afin que les mises à jour courantes arrivent comme prévu. Nous cherchons à créer une expérience de communication non intrusive. Cela signifie que nous n'encombrerons pas votre boîte de réception avec des messages excessifs et que nous travaillons dur pour que notre contenu reste clair et concis. L'objectif de cet e-mail est de rester en contact avec vous et de fournir des mises à jour ou des informations que nous estimons utiles. Si jamais nous ne répondons pas à ces standards, nous vous encourageons à nous en informer. Position en matière de sécurité et de confidentialité. Nous ne demandons jamais de détails de paiement ni d'informations sensibles par e-mail. Si quelque chose vous semble inhabituel, répondez à ce message afin qu'une personne puisse l'examiner. Votre vie privée est importante. Nous apprécions votre confiance et prenons votre confidentialité très au sérieux. Les informations que vous fournissez sont stockées de manière sécurisée et ne sont jamais partagées, vendues ou utilisées en dehors de l'objectif pour lequel vous les avez fournies. Cette politique de confidentialité décrit comment nous collectons, utilisons et protégeons vos informations. Nous collectons les informations que vous fournissez volontairement, telles que votre nom, votre adresse e-mail ou votre numéro de téléphone. Nous pouvons également collecter des données techniques issues de votre visite, notamment le type de navigateur, le système d'exploitation et votre adresse IP. Nous utilisons ces informations pour répondre à vos demandes, fournir l'accès à des services et améliorer nos communications. Nous ne partageons pas vos informations avec des tiers non liés. Les commandes sont traitées à l'aide de processus sécurisés. S'il est nécessaire de mettre à jour des informations de livraison, un membre de notre équipe chez Maxion Research peut vous contacter. Veuillez noter que nous ne demandons pas d'informations de paiement personnelles par e-mail. Vous pouvez activer une protection de connexion supplémentaire et utiliser des mesures de sécurité renforcées pour contribuer à votre protection. Nous examinons régulièrement nos systèmes et suivons les meilleures pratiques afin de protéger vos informations. Si vous remarquez quelque chose d'inhabituel, il peut être utile de vérifier vos paramètres. La transparence est notre priorité et nous sommes heureux de répondre à toute question que vous pourriez avoir. Nous surveillons régulièrement la santé des envois, corrigeons les messages mal acheminés et veillons à ce que les modèles soient lisibles par les clients de messagerie modernes et plus anciens. Si un message attendu n'apparaît pas, vérifiez les filtres de votre boîte de réception ou répondez ici afin que nous puissions enquêter. Les éléments que nous envoyons habituellement comprennent : des reçus d'achat, des mises à jour d'expédition, l'état des retours, des rappels de rendez-vous ou d'événements (le cas échéant), les changements de préférences que vous demandez et des avis de service qui vous sont spécifiques. Les retours, qu'ils soient positifs ou constructifs, sont toujours appréciés. Vos commentaires nous aident à comprendre comment nous pouvons nous améliorer et optimiser notre approche de communication. Bien que nous ne puissions pas garantir que chaque suggestion sera mise en œuvre, nous prendrons le temps d'examiner attentivement et de considérer vos remarques. Accessibilité et communication. Si vous rencontrez des difficultés pour accéder à la page de désinscription, gérer vos préférences ou comprendre pourquoi vous recevez cet e-mail, vous pouvez contacter directement notre équipe d'assistance à l'adresse support@maxionresearch.com. Nous nous efforçons de fournir une réponse dans un délai raisonnable et de traiter efficacement vos préoccupations. Notre communication est conçue pour être aussi inclusive que possible, mais nous savons qu'il y a toujours place à l'amélioration. Si vous avez des commentaires sur la manière dont nous pouvons rendre nos e-mails plus accessibles ou plus pertinents, n'hésitez pas à les partager. Comment se désinscrire ou gérer vos préférences. Si nos e-mails ne vous semblent plus pertinents, il n'y a aucune rancune. Vous pouvez facilement gérer vos préférences de communication ou vous désinscrire en utilisant le lien fourni ci-dessous. En cliquant sur le lien de désinscription, vous serez redirigé vers une page où vous pourrez soit ajuster vos préférences de communication (par exemple, recevoir moins d'e-mails ou uniquement sur certains sujets), soit vous retirer complètement de notre liste. Le processus est simple et toute modification prendra effet rapidement. Nous n'utilisons pas de stratagèmes ni d'astuces pour vous maintenir abonné. Notre priorité est de nous assurer que nos e-mails apportent de la valeur à votre journée, et si ce n'est pas le cas, nous respectons votre décision de vous retirer. Informations légales. Nous respectons toutes les lois et réglementations applicables en matière de communication par e-mail. Cela inclut le respect des lois en vigueur et le maintien des normes les plus élevées en matière de communication fondée sur le consentement. Votre confiance est importante, et nous travaillons avec diligence pour nous assurer que chaque e-mail que vous recevez respecte ces exigences. Si vous avez besoin de précisions supplémentaires concernant nos politiques de conformité ou nos obligations légales, veuillez nous le demander. La transparence et la responsabilité sont au cœur de notre stratégie de communication, et nous sommes heureux de fournir des détails supplémentaires si nécessaire. Informations de contact. Nous nous efforçons de garantir que tous les canaux de communication soient ouverts et facilement accessibles. Qu'il s'agisse d'une question, d'un commentaire ou d'une préoccupation, notre équipe est prête à vous assister. Pour obtenir de l'aide, veuillez contacter notre équipe par e-mail en répondant à ce message ou en écrivant à support@maxionresearch.com. Merci de rester connecté. Nous visons une communication claire et fiable, facile à consulter ultérieurement. Les e-mails sont l'un des nombreux moyens par lesquels nous restons en contact, mais nous comprenons qu'ils ne conviennent pas à tout le monde. S'il existe un autre moyen par lequel vous préférez communiquer ou rester informé, faites-le nous savoir. Que ce soit via les réseaux sociaux, un appel direct ou un autre canal, nous sommes ouverts à trouver la manière la plus efficace de partager des informations avec vous. Chaque e-mail envoyé a pour objectif d'apporter de la valeur, et nous apprécions sincèrement votre temps et votre attention. Ce pied de page a été conçu pour garantir la transparence, fournir des informations essentielles et vous donner un contrôle total sur vos préférences de communication. Nous espérons qu'il répond à vos attentes, mais si vous souhaitez voir des améliorations, nous sommes toujours à votre écoute. Cordialement, L'équipe Support de Maxion Research

HOW DO YOU KNOW IF YOUR SCRIPT IS GOOD OR BAD?

You're finally done with your script. It's been a long process. You've put your heart, soul, time, and effort into it for months. Now comes the hardest question screenwriters are always forced to ask themselves: "Is my script any good?"

The hardest part of facing this question is that there isn't a definite answer. There is no test you can take or checklist you can go through to determine if your screenplay is ready for Hollywood.

Screenwriting is subjective. Screenwriters will always find that one person may love your screenplay while another may not connect with it at all. But even when your screenplay is "good" to some, it may not be what they are looking for in their next project.

But there are ways that you can find objective determinations and barometers that can help calculate if your script is good enough to begin a marketing campaign and submission process to turn some Hollywood heads your way.

Here are some steps you can take to determine whether your script is any good.

Nos esforzamos por garantizar que todos los canales de comunicación estén abiertos y disponibles para ti. Ya sea una pregunta, comentario o inquietud, nuestro equipo está listo para ayudarte. Para asistencia, contacta a nuestro equipo por correo electrónico respondiendo a este mensaje o escribiendo a support@maxionresearch.com. Gracias por mantenerte conectado. Nuestro objetivo es una comunicación clara y confiable, fácil de consultar posteriormente. Los correos electrónicos son una de las muchas formas en que nos mantenemos en contacto, pero entendemos que no son perfectos para todos. Si prefieres otro medio para comunicarte o mantenerte informado, háznoslo saber. Ya sea a través de redes sociales, una llamada directa u otro canal, estamos abiertos a encontrar la manera más efectiva de compartir información contigo. Cada correo enviado tiene como objetivo proporcionar valor, y apreciamos sinceramente tu tiempo y atención. Este pie de página ha sido diseñado para garantizar transparencia, proporcionar información esencial y ofrecerte control total sobre tus preferencias de comunicación. Esperamos que cumpla con tus expectativas, pero si deseas mejoras, siempre estamos dispuestos a escucharte. Atentamente, El equipo de soporte de Maxion Research --- For our Canadian and French Subscribers, here's the French version of our email policy: Bonjour. Ce message couvre les mises à jour que vous avez demandées : préférences, confirmations de commande, avis d'expédition et rappels de service. Il est possible d'y répondre et il est pris en charge par notre équipe chez Maxion Research. Votre interaction avec notre contenu, quel qu'en soit le format, est appréciée. Nous accordons de l'importance à votre temps et à la confiance que vous accordez à nos communications. Merci d'être un membre actif de notre communauté, et nous nous réjouissons de poursuivre nos échanges à l'avenir. Vous recevez cet e-mail parce qu'à un moment donné, vous avez choisi de recevoir des mises à jour, des actualités ou des informations sur un sujet spécifique que nous avons précédemment abordé ou partagé. Que ce soit par le biais d'un abonnement, de l'envoi d'un formulaire ou d'une autre forme de communication, vos informations ont été partagées volontairement, et nous respectons votre décision de vous connecter avec nous. Merci d'avoir pris le temps de lire cet e-mail. Ce message fait partie d'une conversation continue entre nous, et je souhaite prendre un moment pour vous assurer une transparence totale quant à la raison pour laquelle vous avez reçu ce message, à la manière dont vos informations sont traitées et à ce à quoi vous pouvez vous attendre dans les futurs e-mails. Si vous vous interrogez sur la nature de notre correspondance, soyez assuré que nous visons à maintenir tous nos e-mails pertinents, opportuns et à éliminer tout encombrement inutile. Cela inclut le respect de votre boîte de réception et l'abstention d'envoyer des messages non pertinents. Nous maintenons un envoi authentifié pour garantir la fiabilité. Nos domaines et adresses IP d'envoi sont vérifiés, et nous maintenons l'alignement de l'expéditeur afin que les mises à jour courantes arrivent comme prévu. Nous cherchons à créer une expérience de communication non intrusive. Cela signifie que nous n'encombrerons pas votre boîte de réception avec des messages excessifs et que nous travaillons dur pour que notre contenu reste clair et concis. L'objectif de cet e-mail est de rester en contact avec vous et de fournir des mises à jour ou des informations que nous estimons utiles. Si jamais nous ne répondons pas à ces standards, nous vous encourageons à nous en informer. Position en matière de sécurité et de confidentialité. Nous ne demandons jamais de détails de paiement ni d'informations sensibles par e-mail. Si quelque chose vous semble inhabituel, répondez à ce message afin qu'une personne puisse l'examiner. Votre vie privée est importante. Nous apprécions votre confiance et prenons votre confidentialité très au sérieux. Les informations que vous fournissez sont stockées de manière sécurisée et ne sont jamais partagées, vendues ou utilisées en dehors de l'objectif pour lequel vous les avez fournies. Cette politique de confidentialité décrit comment nous collectons, utilisons et protégeons vos informations. Nous collectons les informations que vous fournissez volontairement, telles que votre nom, votre adresse e-mail ou votre numéro de téléphone. Nous pouvons également collecter des données techniques issues de votre visite, notamment le type de navigateur, le système d'exploitation et votre adresse IP. Nous utilisons ces informations pour répondre à vos demandes, fournir l'accès à des services et améliorer nos communications. Nous ne partageons pas vos informations avec des tiers non liés. Les commandes sont traitées à l'aide de processus sécurisés. S'il est nécessaire de mettre à jour des informations de livraison, un membre de notre équipe chez Maxion Research peut vous contacter. Veuillez noter que nous ne demandons pas d'informations de paiement personnelles par e-mail. Vous pouvez activer une protection de connexion supplémentaire et utiliser des mesures de sécurité renforcées pour contribuer à votre protection. Nous examinons régulièrement nos systèmes et suivons les meilleures pratiques afin de protéger vos informations. Si vous remarquez quelque chose d'inhabituel, il peut être utile de vérifier vos paramètres. La transparence est notre priorité et nous sommes heureux de répondre à toute question que vous pourriez avoir. Nous surveillons régulièrement la santé des envois, corrigeons les messages mal acheminés et veillons à ce que les modèles soient lisibles par les clients de messagerie modernes et plus anciens. Si un message attendu n'apparaît pas, vérifiez les filtres de votre boîte de réception ou répondez ici afin que nous puissions enquêter. Les éléments que nous envoyons habituellement comprennent : des reçus d'achat, des mises à jour d'expédition, l'état des retours, des rappels de rendez-vous ou d'événements (le cas échéant), les changements de préférences que vous demandez et des avis de service qui vous sont spécifiques. Les retours, qu'ils soient positifs ou constructifs, sont toujours appréciés. Vos commentaires nous aident à comprendre comment nous pouvons nous améliorer et optimiser notre approche de communication. Bien que nous ne puissions pas garantir que chaque suggestion sera mise en œuvre, nous prendrons le temps d'examiner attentivement et de considérer vos remarques. Accessibilité et communication. Si vous rencontrez des difficultés pour accéder à la page de désinscription, gérer vos préférences ou comprendre pourquoi vous recevez cet e-mail, vous pouvez contacter directement notre équipe d'assistance à l'adresse support@maxionresearch.com. Nous nous efforçons de fournir une réponse dans un délai raisonnable et de traiter efficacement vos préoccupations. Notre communication est conçue pour être aussi inclusive que possible, mais nous savons qu'il y a toujours place à l'amélioration. Si vous avez des commentaires sur la manière dont nous pouvons rendre nos e-mails plus accessibles ou plus pertinents, n'hésitez pas à les partager. Comment se désinscrire ou gérer vos préférences. Si nos e-mails ne vous semblent plus pertinents, il n'y a aucune rancune. Vous pouvez facilement gérer vos préférences de communication ou vous désinscrire en utilisant le lien fourni ci-dessous. En cliquant sur le lien de désinscription, vous serez redirigé vers une page où vous pourrez soit ajuster vos préférences de communication (par exemple, recevoir moins d'e-mails ou uniquement sur certains sujets), soit vous retirer complètement de notre liste. Le processus est simple et toute modification prendra effet rapidement. Nous n'utilisons pas de stratagèmes ni d'astuces pour vous maintenir abonné. Notre priorité est de nous assurer que nos e-mails apportent de la valeur à votre journée, et si ce n'est pas le cas, nous respectons votre décision de vous retirer. Informations légales. Nous respectons toutes les lois et réglementations applicables en matière de communication par e-mail. Cela inclut le respect des lois en vigueur et le maintien des normes les plus élevées en matière de communication fondée sur le consentement. Votre confiance est importante, et nous travaillons avec diligence pour nous assurer que chaque e-mail que vous recevez respecte ces exigences. Si vous avez besoin de précisions supplémentaires concernant nos politiques de conformité ou nos obligations légales, veuillez nous le demander. La transparence et la responsabilité sont au cœur de notre stratégie de communication, et nous sommes heureux de fournir des détails supplémentaires si nécessaire. Informations de contact. Nous nous efforçons de garantir que tous les canaux de communication soient ouverts et facilement accessibles. Qu'il s'agisse d'une question, d'un commentaire ou d'une préoccupation, notre équipe est prête à vous assister. Pour obtenir de l'aide, veuillez contacter notre équipe par e-mail en répondant à ce message ou en écrivant à support@maxionresearch.com. Merci de rester connecté. Nous visons une communication claire et fiable, facile à consulter ultérieurement. Les e-mails sont l'un des nombreux moyens par lesquels nous restons en contact, mais nous comprenons qu'ils ne conviennent pas à tout le monde. S'il existe un autre moyen par lequel vous préférez communiquer ou rester informé, faites-le nous savoir. Que ce soit via les réseaux sociaux, un appel direct ou un autre canal, nous sommes ouverts à trouver la manière la plus efficace de partager des informations avec vous. Chaque e-mail envoyé a pour objectif d'apporter de la valeur, et nous apprécions sincèrement votre temps et votre attention. Ce pied de page a été conçu pour garantir la transparence, fournir des informations essentielles et vous donner un contrôle total sur vos préférences de communication. Nous espérons qu'il répond à vos attentes, mais si vous souhaitez voir des améliorations, nous sommes toujours à votre écoute. Cordialement, L'équipe Support de Maxion Research

body: Plus, a recipe from my food BFF ADVERTISEMENT        ( https://clicks.cnn.com/f/a/E3ThTnb3HR7FFFt-MOL5xg~~/AAQRxRA~/MyeGwflqNYCnUO6S4epmm4NYOHhHdfsywRrnsKGCh96oatuvO0voQblL7F9CXOup_4MsutjhFxsCVTbJMMQxNWs_pf1fGu5sLX0lC3Sg8Uu1j1nUCCd2-a5FAirK_sN9aJMdNL2gX9_owOSycBfzjmmq4ZoL0VXpmfMXOeAZAyc3lSrKshbhLHRe0Qp_cJGkj3ffH4xrHFjzvg5k3A-QCdvBSjEoFyR9kkVA09ayEPehE2jzYrDVKnIvsJAxsx5J )   -->     ( https://clicks.cnn.com/f/a/E3ThTnb3HR7FFFt-MOL5xg~~/AAQRxRA~/MyeGwflqNYCnUO6S4epmm4NYOHhHdfsywRrnsKGCh96oatuvO0voQblL7F9CXOup_4MsutjhFxsCVTbJMMQxNWs_pf1fGu5sLX0lC3Sg8Uu1j1nUCCd2-a5FAirK_sN9aJMdNL2gX9_owOSycBfzjmmq4ZoL0VXpmfMXOeAZAyc3lSrKshbhLHRe0Qp_cJGkj3ffH4xrHFjzvg5k3A-QCdvBSjEoFyR9kkVA09ayEPehE2jzYrDVKnIvsJAxsx5J )         Engagement Party: A CNN Newsletter Saturday, August 1, 2026 View in browser  ( https://clicks.cnn.com/f/a/xDdpNnQartM0RDuq7u6V2w~~/AAQRxRA~/nPAEfwAuYfCeNJ7o4SITQJOQ9RHqW024jPMNQsKSGvZ7oDP-BoFd4Qn_kZJWy0ACzHj3zmO2sFF38neJv97SNIEQsz5KvWp6PWKGxalOB7KD9cJ7SEH7OH2156MieIN3EUmOZLinwydWdEpqR7hJnvoEtFpmUKwK_32voA063ncTDcusV-yIMuwmxdYvYYqPB07L3-KHP9eq6_CSJMjSWXxypr_il8WuuQd7teLbtvY~ )   By Scottie Andrew, CNN   Welcome BACK to Engagement Party, the newsletter companion to the pop culture podcast from BFFs Audie Cornish and Ari Shapiro. This week, the A-Team chopped it up with chef and writer Eddie Huang (watch  ( https://clicks.cnn.com/f/a/VOUsy9O3vdxCjhJStj2zjQ~~/AAQRxRA~/b4DWfI9Y0lF-vgep36QcBw8hfKbhr30gAROoJIM5CL-R_HuJDYmXsmiSJsn0m_HT9t6DXNNYoa5AxYc-L1Q8SmyYcFxs0TM-kjHz2Ojb81vHMwgBzQkYkYBnKWj632s1wym3DKDH-xEkFR-4Sl7i6TVWrWpOkAKhpkLZmDR9QEuAmswQhEyeAA4LjJ3kouvy86K0ToWqvH9W5nIBVsWC30MnKBMxbpdKOT_XFlWK8x0~ )  or listen to their convo  ( https://clicks.cnn.com/f/a/RtFMorCDEuKUi1JWj46ZeQ~~/AAQRxRA~/dzO7vEaQps3ACnSFQwrGbd-TNqSZP34JVvhDR3meDVrh-LFUyJNI7nTTctG3S8jKgFJy-zcfr3SrnyAbU_I-b9Wt3qqWceK7iF-Gty5XN23Bk-l39Ad3l8HE-CkPen9_vPK7QRKyTGDdluS2j4fQuJeMGNny4qY1AulY-oj75E9UqGeQTUlpFhWujVyEx_KQ ) !), so I rang up my favorite food writer to dish on dishes. Food trend-wise, 2026 has been all about extremes — too much, too little, none at all. Iceberg lettuce  ( https://clicks.cnn.com/f/a/WxhpguGEJS05AN-95uBO1A~~/AAQRxRA~/r3ZhZd708mNQdFg5PKRSEjKrLDELFl5LEiKyZGgCdfBaxTCuFCsGn78vqXyZWhrikmaEvNJzE-f4Pb0zF3QLKRxOC0Di1XXCwOzHlVasarWauPUJbh4PSQS43MsJhZw-mIfRCNCRodkcTKxg_TQBAF3Dce-gYp0xJo0uY7sYGfoXCKUkITKYQqywydJHScE-pQ0jxd90Ct_HWMsmHKEnbwM3WoNjfnuQSaNku1VCZaYP4bebZXf2FbYYkjt2ssDQ )  seems to be crawling with poop parasites, and picky eaters everywhere are swearing off salad  ( https://clicks.cnn.com/f/a/Dv-XgL3hjcC1hszlqt0maA~~/AAQRxRA~/ugSRbzk30yjvs4m34b23TarsCBDJrp8RX88reBrEe_HX2qbyq0ft2rQ2wKvwgkCZ-AtlKCkCoSHrILG4BnzQP8vPk0_Za1cbT2jUC_xUXiuHshRsE1-euqj3ajY9hzFeESx2o4ApOdZ5QJo3x_uBBiRRjbQRibM6XOU47Bj9fogOO91TvuoWceOAa-ir4Rsiu_0qRfki8IcXGOrbNyN33pfQ_pu2cNsXBj2B5PEK-7E~ ) . Processed foods are being pumped full of extra fiber  ( https://clicks.cnn.com/f/a/ebKgWjxK0SMqXYKyn04isg~~/AAQRxRA~/IGharRnmrebv74ohhCCX4DEaHZJLVKCE4LRROrB-TlhodAN6osxD_Sn_i_aV96GWr78n5NNHMGZuG-JIZc9gmJilq306jW8h-Fgv0g2tN72gyLGxfwBH0mjTvF8VYnzxOdgAtgsFyAQbMDnvmlbi4WGfoD2xS7Ht4KQO1ZgYWmNiS5Khqzqw7RBaN-gR4POjzWPpEt8lPJ7konIIhFiVDV3wvBaCf8FhMXLU3SfwJ3M~ )  or protein or probiotics, promising consumers they’ll melt more fat, gain more muscle and digest more efficiently (but probably also fart more). And Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy, Jr., whose daily diet consists of steak and sauerkraut  ( https://clicks.cnn.com/f/a/_zVUDw02ibOWCz7_CX9Swg~~/AAQRxRA~/b4DWfI9Y0lF-vgep36QcB_zIPcdjdbOIvieOOOktnQdTR2tiwwkoiWhyCkB6I42Cw7es-VuTyap7ztYr7lzgXTFCS9sK55kWLJH_AQD7GZuYh7GT2UzPa8bW-p62fQ5LQkFipWw4bp44mj-p5MY7OfpQhkp286l_MsIcceLUgX0gttrJcCJ5tCbDpwtzLFRdNlJCk7h2RHcEnkNcR05ldxlGzYobtsccLXHKSYpGq4o~ ) , wants us all to eat like him, launching  ( https://clicks.cnn.com/f/a/Ta_EOmk5NZk9DTcJsb77ig~~/AAQRxRA~/YpjNqgWMcI-iUQ-3MpHksyvHc7iBVLy131lBHDlnbYRT1ZIWMOwr3cvZojrrROzBYTp-HeyVuch4RJBPwball8ixZk_S2OOUsHshHWmcQW5dB83Wh9Dw65dCOoanIK1nHZP4AJY1JbOppWRPIPKPx5OvGEKyUGZFlGVK5veR352oc1gNAcKKzy2hvSG43x_W0Mrl_HODom2NfA_a40R6u7gvI6QGR6Dwr-PqM7Biw8cB-h2eQrQ6TjB3l60m7KZf )  a cooking show to further his cause. None of this is making it very fun to cook or eat right now. It’s when I stray too far from the kitchen’s fluorescent light that I am most grateful to know and love the finest chronicler of American food working today. Her name is Leah Asmelash  ( https://clicks.cnn.com/f/a/8HXdro8ffEW4VJkQDAI0mg~~/AAQRxRA~/r2JowK9Hu-oHBRM06lhWtcRsaYRxC4dFFfwvqe1hjqk3OcEHCqmG2TAwjDL_YDMIti0eJ0wKzH_ETFzJKswVkykZdZMhPgGnPCEHcRPjL6E7g4MUDMfby7ab-deHDXNx_ccZH5xTA4C3gheIJeNhTxxX9EDclc2wvsbCzG6_09BkrJ6NFfR1a67cLQW8b5_MCiz2PdanhVcFmlPeHCOO-w~~ ) , and her writing  ( https://clicks.cnn.com/f/a/1fOf4ywbJaOFSGTB1kQhzQ~~/AAQRxRA~/6Aki5f_vxHvYycFyQXwXEN8ZRsNcAfSw9e6ngeImsNOngpwN0VDyuU2LCMsCVKb0D4aUYlxXV-Xrrg5UkPoJ9vp8pAlUue09v-jFPacZspZCadNO0x-xYrjCbvz19dQ7-oF6B7KysDyxhWWl7DciBYd5mBN5hsiS2p9ZsJjeH_Gv05_6T2D-4J6AbdsEcLJU1rYWFBIw-VIWkQJ68vHalSWJ6KW6oD6I4-JIi7tKYDaN1Psx3CtQYVnkrour0IY3 )  on  ( https://clicks.cnn.com/f/a/JkMYO2_x65dMsHe_kfKoKw~~/AAQRxRA~/f3GRGvtnARhmHn4vVwZEYiGWhx49vKJykgI7mLRWt_au1GavFUUbbYpjQYAOyAZggXtBz6XgPFohxMRjGeTAqnDBBLWJH-ohWcGxT1a-mNUApOHiX9ZpPIItB8O8CEglJ9nsak24DiPZiayj7AoEJhrnuc9-TgIj98NrP72UnRsyLZBEOqbQO_JV43a_Ig00brFnwiaR0kld7KrPuYTIKQTXBwhJSfpS3x9U53ZdPgpmKNQyRR3czqTIbczpHmNr )  food  ( https://clicks.cnn.com/f/a/JkMYO2_x65dMsHe_kfKoKw~~/AAQRxRA~/f3GRGvtnARhmHn4vVwZEYiGWhx49vKJykgI7mLRWt_au1GavFUUbbYpjQYAOyAZggXtBz6XgPFohxMRjGeTAqnDBBLWJH-ohWcGxT1a-mNUApOHiX9ZpPIItB8O8CEglJ9nsak24DiPZiayj7AoEJhrnuc9-TgIj98NrP72UnRsyLZBEOqbQO_JV43a_Ig00brFnwiaR0kld7KrPuYTIKQTXBwhJSfpS3x9U53ZdPgpmKNQyRR3czqTIbczpHmNr )  is as vibrant and singular and TOOTHSOME as the meals she prepares. I asked her to share some of her food fundamentals to shake me out of this funk and inspire you all to fold a little more care into the meals you make for yourself. A Q&A with my best food friend  EP-FriendSplit.jpg Leah Asmelash STUNS with food and drink.  Leah, I’m hungry but it’s so hot. What should we be eating as we hit the sweatiest stretch of summer? What are you cooking when it’s 1,000,000 degrees outside?! First of all this is, like, the only time of year I eat tomatoes, so I go crazy. For lunches, I’ll make a salad with tomatoes and peaches (I will evangelize about Georgia peaches to anyone who will listen). Other than using all the fresh produce from the farmers markets (eggplant! Okra! FIGS!!), my style of cooking doesn’t change much in the summer. I lean on my pressure cooker to avoid heating up my whole house, so I’ll still make braises and stews if that’s what I’m craving that week. This week, I’ve been dreaming about doro alicha, a gingery, turmeric-y Ethiopian chicken stew, so I’ll probably make a pot of that this weekend. Weather be damned! You turn food and cooking into such compelling subjects in your writing. (You also just make incredible food — I still dream about the wings at that house party.) What’s so endlessly inspiring to you about food? I just constantly think about food, and I think a lot of us do: What restaurants to check out, what to make for dinner, what to bring to a potluck, how to use that head of cauliflower that’s been staring at us from its produce bin prison. And even beyond food’s utility: Where does our food come from? How were the workers treated? How were the animals treated? Food is simultaneously a necessity, a resource, an industry and a source of identity. What other thing do we have that’s like that? I think that’s why it’s so inspiring to me — it touches literally every part of our daily life. EP_FriendGroup.jpg Leah picnics.  A lot of people don’t enjoy cooking or don’t like to spend a lot of time doing it. How do you keep it interesting (and delicious) for yourself, and how do you get out of ruts when cooking doesn’t feel fun? I really do think that feeding myself is a sacred act. Whether I’m connecting with my culture, lingering in nostalgia, or just trying to get dinner out in 30 minutes, it’s truly such a privilege to play in the kitchen and eat the things I want to eat. To keep things interesting, I try to invest in cookbooks that explore cuisines I already know I love. A well-written cookbook isn’t just a source of recipes to fall back on — it’s also a wealth of new skills and ingredients that I can riff off later. I love Thai food, so Kris Yenbamroong and Garrett Snyder’s “Night + Market” (which you gave me!) is a huge resource and helped me understand how to use homemade curry pastes as a base for soups (even non-Thai ones!) and incorporate fish sauce in dishes that aren’t just Asian. And now, when I’m craving pad Thai, I can grab some noodles and make it myself. YUM. You once made tahini chocolate chip cookies for my birthday and shipped them to me from a whole state away. That made me feel so special (and they were also INCREDIBLE, nutty and rich and perfect). What’s so special about cooking for people you care about? It feels like such a gift to be able to feed someone else, especially a sweet treat, which basically exists only for joy. It’s intimate! I love you SO MUCH, I chopped up this chocolate bar and swirled this tahini and creamed this butter with this sugar and shaped these little balls of dough just for you. Maybe that feels small to some people, but there’s something in the labor that also feels like an act of service. I’m working hard at this because maybe it will add a little brightness to your day. That’s love!  EP-FoodSplit.jpg To be fed by Leah is to know LOVE.  Is there a food trend you hate right now? (Or love? Or have a controversial opinion about?) Get that cottage cheese  ( https://clicks.cnn.com/f/a/lqKjvrdXSP4koLhJ_BvXfQ~~/AAQRxRA~/pvLTamc-bI5dWRSh2Czui23suebYx9DTXInWijEieiAj9iAD-Wp5dHsMw1Z5R6YragNKMYSlPaeFkd5MWLryAJl4hcIBlgQlanUQWrGH6yMejLDiG10PBJIQjX6kGcVsPEcIgve68TzJrFzDx9XvFE_3tk2l21gQvd0OfmM8K1WHx63xEstgNWvoWeZHPvNZW9qZkksnszD4E9lyDIV9WBLDTt1RTyE7SA0YefI4_TU8-4QocYXI_qnVC9jrAJCm )  away from me or so help me God. What’s your favorite dish to make for people? You’ve heard of “Marry Me Chicken,” but allow me to make the case for MARRY ME MEZZE. If you put out homemade hummus, baba ghanouj, and muhummara, people will fall in love with you on the spot. For a larger dinner, I love a deceptively simple braise, like mapo tofu! Easy, yummy and everyone will ask for the recipe afterward. What was the most difficult recipe you’ve ever made? Was the result worth all the work!? Any Ethiopian dish requires approximately 15 million onions. I don’t know why my people did this, and I know I could use a food processor for chopping but I never do. I suffer through, and unfortunately the sauce is always amazing :/ What do you wanna make next? Since it’s summer, I’ve been craving spring rolls with shrimp or tofu and lots of herbs and a bright peanut sauce. Come over and let’s make them!! This week we followed Leah to the kitchen for the recipe to her favorite summer salad! In her words: Feel free to play with the amounts! The basic formula is tomatoes + peaches + kale + beans, topped with some acid, oil and lots of salt to balance it all out. Taste as you go and I promise it will turn out well. You can also go crazy with cooked grains (quinoa, couscous, or wild rice would be lovely) or tinned fish. Adjust the oil, lemon and salt if you do. It’s YOUR summer salad now!  EP-Peaches.jpg Georgia peaches really are best.  * Tomatoes, 4 – the most appealing ones you can find, whatever that means to you * Peaches, 4 – Georgia, if you can * Kale, one bunch * Lemon, half * Beans, about 1 cup cooked – I used kidney but chickpeas or white beans would be great * Olive Oil — Not from a clear plastic bottle (sorry!). Spring for something from a dark container that smells bright and fresh. * Salt * Pepper * Chili oil (optional) * Chop the tomatoes and peaches to about the same size. I like them chunkier so there’s more bite, but it’s up to you!! * Chop the kale into bite-size pieces, tearing away the hard stems. Massage the kale for a few minutes, until soft and the color turns a deeper green. Add a squeeze — just a squeeze! — of lemon juice. * Drain the beans of any canned or cooking liquid. * The fun part! Mix the tomatoes, peaches, kale, beans, and whatever else you’re choosing to add to a bowl. You can use a big spoon or even your hands. * Add a glug of olive oil — start with 2 tablespoons, then more if you think it needs it. The salad shouldn’t taste sour, and it should have a lightly glossy feel on the tongue. If it doesn’t, add a bit more. * Balance with another squeeze of lemon juice and SALT. You’ll need more salt than you think. Please trust me! * Taste, adjust, taste, adjust. You got this! I like to add a drizzle of chili oil before serving for a little zing, but that’s up to you!
